name: Team Squirtle: Bulky Balance & Weather Inversion
archetype: Water/Flying weather inverter starter, 120 Speed Ground/Fighting breaker, and Fire/Ground physical wallbreaker.
gym_duel_rationale: Erika enforces a strict 3v3 duel. Lead with Blastoise/Fearow (496 BST Water/Flying with 92 Speed neutralizing Grass weakness, eliminating Sunny Day via Rain Dance, and hitting Tangela/Primeape with 4x STAB Drill Peck and Roost). Back with Dugtrio/Primeape (120 Speed Ground/Fighting sweeper with 100 BP Earthquake and Cross Chop) and Flareon/Sandslash (505 BST physical breaker with 110 Attack, Swords Dance, and Fire Fang/Lava Plume).

roster.progression_notes: Blastoise splices with Fearow. 496 BST with 92 Speed and 90 SpD. Neutral to Grass; Rain Dance extinguishes Sunny Day, halving Solar Beam. 4x STAB Drill Peck crushes Tangela/Primeape with Roost recovery.
439 BST speedster boasting 120 Base Speed and 95 Attack. Natural 100 BP Earthquake (Lv. 35) combined with high-crit Cross Chop easily breaks grounded targets.

roster.status: Active in Party (Celadon Stone & Route 4 Splice)
roster.progression_notes: Gift Eevee evolved with Fire Stone (Dept Store 4F) and spliced with Sandslash. 505 BST with 110 Base Attack, 93 Defense, and Swords Dance boosting.

roster.status: Active in Party (Route 24 & Celadon Sewers Splice)
roster.progression_notes: 462 BST with 108 Special Attack and 90 Defense. Levitate removes Ground weakness while STAB Psychic and Sludge Bomb deliver wide coverage.

roster.status: Active in Party (Route 24 & Celadon Stone Splice)
roster.progression_notes: Gloom (Leaf Stone) and Poliwhirl (Water Stone) stone-evolved and spliced. 510 BST with 91 Defense and 90 SpD, absorbing incoming Grass and Water attacks.

flex_bench.why_use: Retained for wild catches with Compound Eyes 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder.
Evolved from Clefairy with Lavender Moon Stone. Magic Guard blocks indirect and hazard damage.

Dugtrio/Primeape (439 BST 120 Spe Ground/Fighting sweeper with Earthquake and Cross Chop)

unfuse_recommendations: 1. Celadon Poké Mart: Pay $300 to unfuse Wartortle/Geodude from Chapter 3.
2. Level Wartortle to Lv. 36 to evolve into Blastoise.
3. Splice Blastoise with Fearow using Super Splicer for 4x Drill Peck and Roost.
4. Unfuse Dugtrio/Fearow and Poliwhirl/Sandslash from Chapter 3; splice Dugtrio with Primeape, and Sandslash with newly evolved Flareon (gift Eevee via Fire Stone).
5. Catch Koffing in Celadon Sewers, evolve at Lv. 35 into Weezing, and splice with Kadabra for Levitate Ground immunity.
upcoming_fusions: Blastoise/Alakazam (Endgame Special titan with Linking Cord)
